title: Player character
description: A PC record. Only $schemaVersion and name are required. The runtime renders whatever fields are present; absent fields are simply omitted from view.

player.description: Optional name of the human player. May be a handle, real name, or omitted.

stats.description: Six-stat block. Each defaults to 0 if absent.

skills.description: Category masteries. Each name should match a known category (Action, Subterfuge, Knowledge, Insight, Influence, Tech, Craft, Medic) but the validator does not enforce this.

tags.description: Open free-text expertise tags from backstory.

harm.description: Number of filled boxes on the 4-box Harm track.

stress.description: Number of filled boxes on the 4-box Stress track.

foci.description: Cognitive anchors for casting. Each focus has a domain and an optional condition.

domain.description: What category of intent this focus resonates with. E.g. 'identity', 'emotion', 'systems', 'motion'.

advancements.description: Number of advancements taken. Cap is 8.

marks.description: Convenience mirror of the number of ticked markBullets. DERIVED — markBullets is the source of truth and the runtime counts those. Kept in sync for human readers and print output.

backstory.description: Freeform Markdown. The primary place for character voice, history, and motivation. Should REFLECT (not restage) the intention-under-pressure moment — the verbatim player answer to that question is preserved separately as `intentionUnderPressure`.

intentionUnderPressure.description: Player-visible. The player's verbatim 2-4 sentence answer to the chargen prompt 'what in your life taught you to hold an intention against pressure?' — preserved as a first-class structured field (not just folded into `backstory` prose) so it survives synthesis/re-sync and remains accessible for the Phase-2 realization mechanic (see rules.md §Trying-too-hard — tax recovery requires a DM-granted 'quiet moment of release' that mirrors this formative intent). DM-only mechanical gloss lives under `dmNotes.intentionUnderPressureNote`.

meaningfulItem.description: Player-visible. Verbatim answer to the chargen 'one personally meaningful item your PC carries' prompt. Load-bearing: this is typically the seed for the PC's `focus` (per underleaf archetypes.md).

specificPlace.description: Player-visible. Verbatim answer to the chargen 'one specific Bay Area neighborhood, route, or place that is yours' prompt. DM uses at play time as a retrocausal-anchor scene lever.

temperamentUnderPressure.description: Player-visible. Canonical MC value from the chargen 'when things get hard, what does your PC do?' prompt. Underleaf values: `quiet` / `argues` / `acts` / `question`. Voice signal for the AI + DM at play time.

priorConnectionKind.description: Canonical MC value from the chargen 'did your PC know one of the other PCs before Flight 887?' prompt. Underleaf values: `none` / `work` / `school` / `neighbors` / `estranged-family` / `online` / `history`. Threads with the bond-draft flow.

flightReason.description: Canonical MC value from the chargen 'why are you on Flight 887 to Taipei?' prompt. Underleaf values: `work` / `family` / `love` / `running-from` / `running-toward` / `opportunistic` / `last-72h`. Load-bearing for Ep 1.

intentionHorizon.description: Canonical MC value from the chargen 'the moment that taught you to hold an intention against pressure happened...' prompt. Underleaf values: `childhood` / `school` / `first-job` / `specific-year` / `ongoing`. Temporal companion to `intentionUnderPressure`.

relationships.description: References to NPCs by id or name.

resources.description: Resources the PC has access to: safe houses, contacts, equipment, vehicles.

threadDebt.description: Soft narrative state. DM-tracked. Free-text summary of how much the world has 'noticed' this PC's casting.

knowsTheyCanCast.description: Whether this PC has completed the realization phase of the magic-discovery arc. Defaults to false.

tryingTooHardSessionsRemaining.description: Sessions remaining of the -2 'trying-too-hard' tax after realization. 0 when fully resolved.

markBullets.description: Which of the five advancement criteria are ticked in the current cycle. Five ticks unlocks an advancement and resets.

markLog.description: Append-only record of WHY each mark was assigned, so the reason survives the cycle reset and can be surfaced in the UI. Entries persist across advancements even though markBullets clears.

episode.description: Episode id or number the mark was earned in.

criterion.description: The criterion's full text, denormalised for display.

note.description: What the PC actually did. This is the thing worth showing a player.

reconstructed.description: True if reverse-engineered after the fact rather than recorded at the table.
